name: Stormbringer
lore: Black runesword, forged by the Lords of Chaos at the dawn of the Young Kingdoms. It drinks souls and feeds them to its bearer; Elric of Melnibone leaned on it for his strength and lost everyone he loved to its hunger. At the end of the world the blade laughed and named itself a god. It will turn in the hand if the chance is right.
curve_note: base_damage = curve.weapon_base_damage(88) x 1.8 unique-mult, boss-tier signature. Class: heavy 5-rung [0.75, 0.90, 1.00, 1.30, 1.75]. F80-89 Fenrir-era band fill; Elric / Moorcock canon.
